description: CAD 50m over five years
An additional CAD 50m announced through AI for All to expand CAISI capabilities.
notes: The retrieved sources publish no funding period or annual profile, so we do not annualise it, do not use it in place of the 2024 five-year allocation, and do not add the two envelopes to a current annual budget. The one-off label denotes this additional fixed envelope, not payment in one fiscal year. The strategy names CAISI as the recipient, and the Question Period Note explicitly calls this additional funding. It is an institute-wide envelope, kept separate from the earlier five-year allocation rather than added to its annual mean. The Question Period Note also associates the envelope with AI transparency and a Canada Trusted AI Certification programme. It gives no split; the explicit CAISI allocation supports the whole-institute classification while the scope of certification spending remains uncertain.

source_ids: ca-ised-dp-2026-27-tpp; ca-ised-drr-2024-25-tpp; ca-ised-drr-2025-26-tpp; ca-ised-dp-2025-26-tpp; r11-ca-fiscal-year; ca-cifar-year-of-impact-2026
notes: ISED's 2026-27 Departmental Plan lists the CAISI project under the Advanced and Emerging Technology programme with a start of 2024-25 and an end of 2028-29 (CAISI Budget 2024), as does its 2025-26 results report, so this stream sits inside the CAD 50m five-year allocation and is not additional to it. ISED's 2024-25 results report and its 2025-26 Departmental Plan give the start as 2025-26, but the 2024-25 results report also records CAD 2,999,545 of actual spending in 2024-25 against nothing planned, as funding received in-year, and says the stream was launched in November 2024; the record therefore starts in 2024-25. ISED's 2025-26 Departmental Results Report gives CAD 6m as 2025-26 actual spending (authorities used), equal to planned spending. CIFAR reported on 21 January 2026 that the government awarded it CAD 27m through the institute for its AI safety research programme, with no period stated, and that the programme awarded CAD 2.4m in 2025 to 12 projects; both concern this stream and are not added to it.
